thread:
maya: Quick company update — starting 2026-05-01 we're rolling out a new per-minute token rate limit model for the Hosted API plus a short "cushion" (soft-burst) window to reduce surprise throttles. Full details are in the internal doc linked below. :loudspeaker:

maya: TL;DR:
- Rate limits move from requests/sec to tokens/minute. This better matches common usage patterns (longer chats).
- Cushion window: short bursts (configurable per-account) are allowed for 120s before hitting hard throttle; cushion is meter-based not time-based.
- Dedicated customers can opt-out or set custom cushions via their contract UI.
- Private deployments: no changes from us by default — partners can enable the cushion in their on-prem config.
- Free trial credits will now expire after 90 days (was 180). We made this change to align with capacity planning and fraud controls.
- Invoice cutoff moved to the 1st of the month for usage billing (previously 15th). We will prorate the first month for affected customers.

maya: Why this change? We saw many short spikes that created low-level throttling and surprising blown budgets. Tokens/min better reflects cost and lets us expose clearer controls (cushion + explicit burst allowance).

sara (Product): Important for PLG — will this change default routing for free-tier apps? :thinking_face:

maya: sara — default behavior for self-serve users will be the conservative cushion (small), so most apps won't notice unless they have large bursty traffic. We'll surface an in-console callout and suggested upgrades if you hit cushion regularly.

jamie (Eng-SRE): Rollout plan? Can SRE opt-in to provide metrics to customers?

maya: rollout will be staged: internal tenants next week, then customers in small cohorts over 6 weeks. Eng-SRE will get a new metrics dashboard (per-customer tokens/min, cushion usage, throttle events). We'll publish the dashboard link and a webhook for alerts.

jamie (Eng-SRE): Nice. Please include sample alert thresholds. Also can we get a sample header clients will see when throttled?

maya: sure — we'll give a sample HTTP response:
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
X-Redwood-RateLimit-Type: tokens/min
X-Redwood-RateLimit-Limit: 120000
X-Redwood-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-Redwood-RateLimit-Reset: 162
{ "error": "rate_limit_exceeded", "cushion_active": true }
```

vikram (Finance): On invoices — will the cutoff move affect recurring invoices that run mid-month? Need a migration plan for enterprise accounts to avoid double-billing.

maya: vikram — yes we'll coordinate billing migrations. Finance is preparing a one-time prorate and a customer-facing notice. We'll also auto-apply a "migration credit" for accounts we touch to avoid surprises.

vikram (Finance): OK thanks. Please make the customer emails CCR-approved.

billing-bot: Automated summary: policy_change:rate_limit_model_tokens_per_minute; cushion_window:120s; trial_credit_expiry_days:90; invoice_cutoff_day:1; rollout_window_weeks:6; docs:<https://redwood.internal/docs/rate-limits-cushion>

docs-team: Draft of the public-facing docs and in-console copy uploaded: <https://redwood.internal/docs/drafts/rate-limit-msgs>. Please review — we need final copy by 2026-04-10.

maya: Ask support to hold a small AMA for customers who hit cushion in the first month. Support + Sales, please coordinate.

sara (Product): I'll set up the in-console tooltip text and the upgrade CTA.

jamie (Eng-SRE): Adding SRE on-call runbook item: SLOs for throttle error rate and cushion drains.

maya: Thanks everyone. Action items:
- Product: in-console messaging (sara)
- Docs: finalize public docs (docs-team)
- Finance: migration/prorate plan (vikram)
- Eng-SRE: dashboard + alerts + runbook (jamie)
- Support/Sales: customer comms & AMA scheduling

maya: If you have immediate customer questions, ping me or @sara. :rocket:
